title: Todos with tags
summary: A list of things you mean to do, each of which you can tag with a word.
It exists so nothing you meant to do gets forgotten, and so you can see which todos belong together.
You add a todo, tag it, take a tag off, and deleting a todo takes its tags with it.

stories.sentence: You type "buy milk" and press Add; "buy milk" appears in the list, not ticked.
You tag "buy milk" with "shop"; the tag "shop" shows on "buy milk".
You take the tag "shop" off "buy milk"; "buy milk" has no tags.
You delete "buy milk", which is tagged "shop"; the todo and its tag are both gone.

links.sentence: Deleting a todo clears its tags.
